meta.name: alternative-analysis
meta.description: Strategy: What-If Analysis, Alternative Futures, and Four Ways of Seeing — generate competing explanations and scenarios to challenge the dominant narrative.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成竞争性解释和场景，挑战主导叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不确定环境下探索多种可能性并做出更优决策
copy.tagline_en: Generate competing explanations and scenarios to challenge the dominant narrative
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explore multiple possibilities and make better decisions under uncertainty

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会对你的问题生成多种竞争性解释和场景，从不同角度挑战默认结论，并进行假设检验。
howto.when: 当你要求对某个观点或分析进行替代性思考、挑战现有结论，或探索不同可能性时触发。

say.text: 给我这个问题的三种替代解释。
say.note: Claude 会生成多个可能的解释并比较。

say.text: 对当前结论做反事实分析。
say.note: Claude 会改变关键变量，探索其他结果。

say.text: 用四重观察法分析这个方案。
say.note: Claude 会从机会、风险、结构、能动性四个视角审视。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude generates multiple competing explanations and scenarios for your input, challenges the dominant narrative, and performs hypothesis testing across alternatives.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for alternative perspectives, challenge existing conclusions, or explore different possibilities for a given analysis.

say_en.text: Give me three alternative explanations for this problem.
Conduct a what-if analysis on the current conclusion.
say_en.note: Claude varies key variables to explore sensitivity.

say_en.text: Analyze this proposal using four ways of seeing.
say_en.note: Claude examines through opportunity, risk, structure, and agency lenses.
